description: Start building a new app or website on SPOE from a description. kind "website" makes a plain HTML site (fast, can be published at name.spoe.dev); kind "app" makes a full-stack Next.js, Fastify and Postgres app. A second AI from another model family reviews the change. Costs credits from the account: estimated first, charged when the build finishes, never if it fails. Returns the studio link to watch it and the project id for app_status.

description.description: What to build, in plain words: who it is for, the pages, what it should do.

kind.description: website (plain HTML) or app (full stack). Default website.

name.description: A short name for the project.
